reciprocal.link: MO063 — Recognise burnout — motivation can be exhausted
reciprocal.why: Burn-out defined as chronic workplace stress with exhaustion, cynicism and reduced efficacy (WHO ICD-11; Maslach et al., 2001).

reciprocal.link: MO057 — Recognise the importance of self-concordant goals — your goals, not others'
reciprocal.why: Self-concordant goals bring more sustained effort and larger well-being gains (Sheldon and Elliot, 1999).

reciprocal.link: M002 — Expect the cosmos itself to be motion
reciprocal.why: Nahua metaphysics is processive; teotl is energy-in-motion, so the cosmos is motion (Maffie, IEP).
